cards.example: Solusyong panandalian lang ito, hindi ito ang tunay na kasagutan.
cards.exampleMeaning: This is only a stopgap solution, not the real answer.
cards.note: Mas pormal at mas may bigat kaysa sa pangkaraniwang 'pansamantala' — ginagamit sa political at economic commentary kapag binibigyang-diin na hindi pa ito solusyon sa ugat ng problema. Karaniwang pares: solusyong panandalian, ayuda panandalian, kaluwagan panandalian.
cards.tiesTo: BSP's rate response to peso weakness as a short-term fix, not a structural one

cards.meaning: suspicious-looking; giving rise to doubt, though not yet proven
cards.example: Kahina-hinala ang mga kontratang iyon, pero wala pa tayong sapat na ebidensya.
cards.exampleMeaning: Those contracts look suspicious, but we don't have enough evidence yet.
cards.note: Mas malumanay at mas legal/balita ang dating kumpara sa mas diretsahang 'kaduda-duda' — ginagamit kapag may itsura ng mali pero hindi pa napapatunayan. Karaniwang gamit sa court at investigative reporting.
cards.tiesTo: Baste Duterte's denial of knowledge of GenCorp's ties to VP Sara Duterte despite 19 Davao contracts worth over ₱33.2M

cards.meaning: to ease, alleviate (pressure, tension, a crisis) without fully resolving it
cards.example: 尽管美中把关税休战延长到明年一月十日，中国国内的房地产和地方债务危机还是没有缓解。
cards.examplePinyin: jǐnguǎn Měi-Zhōng bǎ guānshuì xiūzhàn yáncháng dào míngnián yī yuè shí rì, Zhōngguó guónèi de fángdìchǎn hé dìfāng zhàiwù wēijī háishi méiyǒu huǎnjiě
cards.exampleMeaning: Although the US and China extended their tariff truce to January 10th next year, China's domestic property and local-government debt crisis still hasn't eased.
cards.note: 书面语/formal register, common in economic and diplomatic news. Near-synonym contrast: 解决 (jiějué, 'to resolve completely') fixes the underlying problem; 缓解 only lessens the severity without touching the root cause. Collocations: 缓解压力、缓解紧张局势、缓解危机、缓解负担.
cards.tiesTo: US-China tariff truce extension vs China's underlying debt-deflation crisis

cards.meaning: to make a concession; to yield or back down (usually one side, often under pressure)
cards.example: 中国在农产品采购上做出了让步，可是稀土交付进度依然落后。
cards.examplePinyin: Zhōngguó zài nóngchǎnpǐn cǎigòu shàng zuò chū le ràngbù, kěshì xītǔ jiāofù jìndù yīrán luòhòu
cards.exampleMeaning: China made concessions on agricultural purchases, but its rare-earth delivery schedule is still behind.
cards.note: 书面语/formal, common in diplomatic and negotiation reporting. Near-synonym contrast: 妥协 (tuǒxié, 'compromise') implies BOTH sides give ground toward a middle point; 让步 specifically marks ONE side yielding. Collocations: 做出让步、作出让步、被迫让步、拒绝让步.
cards.tiesTo: China's partial compliance on Busan-truce deliverables — soybean pledge met, ag-goods and rare-earth commitments lagging
